Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

rpkgkit 0.1.21 (2026-10-19)

NEW FEATURES

  • Added get_positron_version() to report the version of the Positron IDE. It first reads the POSITRON_VERSION environment variable that Positron sets for its R sessions (POSITRON_LONG_VERSION, which includes the build number, when long = TRUE), then falls back to the .ps.positron_version() helper injected by the IDE, and finally to the positron --version command-line tool. When none of them is available it returns NA_character_, so the function is safe to call outside Positron.
  • Added check_sysdeps() to verify that the system development dependencies a package needs at build time are installed. It detects the package manager in use (dpkg, rpm, pacman, apk or brew), or takes it from manager, queries each dependency with that manager, and reports every hit and miss with cli, ending with a ready-to-paste install command for the missing ones. With deps = NULL it checks the built-in list of graphics and font libraries (freetype, libjpeg, libpng, libtiff, libwebp, harfbuzz, fribidi, fontconfig) under the names used by that package manager. The result is returned invisibly as a named logical vector, and verbose = FALSE makes the check silent.
  • Added check_standalone() to verify that a custom standalone file follows the layout consumed by usethis::use_standalone(). It checks three points: the # --- header (the required repo, file, last-updated and license slots, plus the optional imports slot, and the format of each value), that every documented function carries @noRd, and that a # nocov start marker precedes all functions. Findings are printed in the style of devtools::check() and the counts are returned invisibly as list(error = , warning = , note = ); an error in a check point skips the remaining ones, while warnings and notes never stop the run.

MINOR IMPROVEMENTS

  • The version-bumper action now keeps a Rust crate version in sync: when the package ships src/rust/Cargo.toml, the version key of its [package] table is rewritten together with the R package version, under the same NEWS.md guard, while the rest of the manifest is left untouched. Only [package] is inspected, so dependency version keys are never changed, and manifests without a literal version (e.g. version.workspace = true) are skipped. The commit step now stages only the files that exist.

DEPRECATED

  • news_md_check() is deprecated and now warns on every call.

DOCUMENTATION

  • The pkg_maintain vignette gained a “Check system dependencies” section covering check_sysdeps() and a “Detect the Positron version” section covering get_positron_version().
  • The standalone_tools vignette gained a “Validate the standalone file layout” section covering check_standalone().
  • Vignette subtitles now report version 0.1.21.
  • The README now notes that active-file detection in Positron requires Positron 2026.10.1 or later.

rpkgkit 0.1.20 (2026-10-15)

NEW FEATURES

  • Added optimize_rmd_yaml() to enrich the YAML header of one README.Rmd or vignette from the package DESCRIPTION: title, author, date, language, an enriched output block and, for vignettes, the VignetteIndexEntry. A field that still holds its usethis default value (an “Untitled” title, a bare output: rmarkdown::html_vignette) is replaced, a field you changed is kept, and user output options are merged on top of the enriched defaults. package_optimize_rmd_yaml() applies the same logic to README.Rmd and every .Rmd under vignettes/. Both accept extra, extra_readme and extra_vignette for adding custom fields such as params or bibliography.
  • Added use_clangd() to write a .clangd configuration file that wires up system R, Rcpp, RcppEigen, and RcppArmadillo include paths. If path is an R package root, an additional If: block disables clangd’s background indexing for the R/ source directory, and .clangd is added to .Rbuildignore. The include argument lets users pass any custom package names whose include/ directory should be added; packages that are not installed are skipped with a warning.
  • Added the standalone standalone-cli_table.R script, which provides cli_table() and cli_table_oneline() for printing cli-styled frequency tables of a vector, on two aligned lines or on a single header: count line.
  • Added the standalone standalone-make_arg_validator.R script, which provides make_arg_validator(), a factory that turns an unquoted block of checks and coercions written in terms of argument names into a reusable validator returning the validated arguments as a named list.

MINOR IMPROVEMENTS

  • The standalone CLI helpers add_caller_to_cli() (standalone-caller_cli.R), add_colors_to_cli() and create_colorful_cli_env() (standalone-colorful_cli.R), and add_timestamp_to_cli() and create_ts_cli_env() (standalone-ts_cli.R) now validate their arguments: cli_func must be a function and the cli_functions / cli_func vector of create_*_cli_env() must be a character vector, otherwise the call aborts with a cli error naming the argument instead of failing later with a cryptic one.
  • Calls inside these standalone helpers now pass their arguments by name (e.g. sys.call(which = ...), do.call(what = ..., args = ...)).
  • The version-bumper action now refuses to ship a release without a changelog entry: before writing anything it compares the version it is about to set with the highest version documented in NEWS.md and skips the bump (with a warning) when the new version is higher. When NEWS.md is missing or holds no version heading, the check is bypassed with a warning.

DOCUMENTATION

  • The README.Rmd and vignette YAML headers were enriched with optimize_rmd_yaml(), so the vignettes now carry a subtitle with the package version, an author, a date, a lang, a richer output block (table of contents, numbered sections, figure captions) and RStudio editor_options.
  • The README badge block now shows the R-universe version badge; the development-version and last-commit badges were removed.
  • In the news vignette, the section about the package startup message is titled “A startup message” instead of “A spinner startup message” and its chunk no longer echoes the message.
  • The pkg_maintain vignette gained a “Configure the clangd language server” section, and the readme_and_doc vignette an “Enrich Rmd YAML headers” section covering optimize_rmd_yaml() and package_optimize_rmd_yaml(), including the extra, extra_readme and extra_vignette arguments.
  • The standalone_tools vignette documents the new cli_table and make_arg_validator scripts, and its examples now run as labelled, unevaluated knitr chunks with trimmed inquire_standalone() output.

rpkgkit 0.1.19 (2026-10-08)

NEW FEATURES

  • Added convert_pipe() and package_convert_pipe() to switch pipe operators between the tidyverse pipe %>% and the base pipe |>. Strings, comments, and raw strings are left unchanged, as are the placeholder pipe %<>% and the exposition pipe %$%.
  • rename_func() gains a num_to_word argument that expands digit abbreviations in function names into words, defaulting to c("for" = 4, "to" = 2). With the default mapping list2env() becomes list_to_env() and wait4result() becomes wait_for_result(), and the expanded words are formatted following the style argument, e.g. list2env() becomes listToEnv() under style = "camelCase". The argument accepts a named vector, NULL, or FALSE; any other input is an error. Only digit runs present in the mapping are expanded, so identifiers such as scale_x_log10() are left untouched.

MINOR IMPROVEMENTS

  • make_func_call_explicit(), package_func_call_explicit(), and add_double_colons() no longer truncate function names that contain digits. Function calls such as r2dtable() and scale_x_log10() were matched only from their longest digit-free suffix (r2dtable() was treated as dtable()), which either produced invalid namespacing or triggered a spurious “Couldn’t find packages exporting” warning.
  • Added pattern detection for exported datasets, e.g., starwars from dplyr will be detected.
  • Faster make_func_arg_explicit() and package_func_arg_explicit(): large files are now planned several times faster, because the parse table is indexed once and child nodes are looked up in constant time instead of being rescanned for every node. Planning a whole package therefore no longer grows quadratically with its size.

rpkgkit 0.1.18

BUG FIXES

  • convert_int_literals() and package_convert_int_literals() no longer rewrite the exponent of a numeric literal such as 1e-3 / 1E-3, which previously produced invalid code like 1e-3L.

MINOR IMPROVEMENTS

  • check_air_installed() now offers to install air in interactive sessions when it is missing, skipping the prompt during tests. On macOS it now uses the official installer script instead of Homebrew or uv.
  • The package startup message now reports the load time (e.g. loaded [12.34 ms]) instead of showing a progress spinner, and the same template is used by use_zzz().

rpkgkit 0.1.17 (2026-9-22)

NEW FEATURES

  • Added badge_to_readme() to insert a Markdown badge into the badges block of README.Rmd or README.md.
  • Added exported GLOBAL_RBUILDIGNORE_PATTERN and PERMISSIVE_LICENSE constants for customizing package-maintenance workflows.

BUG FIXES

  • add_global_gitgnore() now correctly updates a package specified with an absolute path.
  • use_vendor() now adds only people with an aut or cre role to Authors@R.
  • package_convert_int_literals() now skips automatically generated RcppExports.R files, which should not be edited manually.

MINOR IMPROVEMENTS

  • add_global_rbuildignore() now supports supplying custom patterns and replacing its default pattern set.
  • use_vendor() records vendored-code authors as contributors and copyright holders, rather than package authors.
  • The version-bumper action now updates development-version badges before committing a release version. Its version commits now run CI before test branch synchronization.

DOCUMENTATION

  • Added pkgdown articles for the package vignettes and reorganized the README around the package website guides.

rpkgkit 0.1.16

MINOR IMPROVEMENTS

  • Refactored detect_* and package_* functions.
  • Test-branch synchronization now runs only after R-CMD-check.yaml succeeds for a push to main or master, and syncs the exact checked commit.

rpkgkit 0.1.15

BUG FIXES

  • convert_int_literals(), package_convert_int_literals(), and convert_func_syntax() now forward ... to rlang::check_dots_empty0(). Previously the call was made without ..., so the documented “... must be empty” check was a no-op and extra arguments were silently ignored.

rpkgkit 0.1.14 (2026-09-14)

NEW FEATURES

  • Added use_bugreports() — sets the BugReports field of a package’s DESCRIPTION file, defaulting to the GitHub issues page detected from the git remote.
  • Added use_url() — sets the URL field of a package’s DESCRIPTION file, defaulting to the GitHub repository detected from the git remote, with an optional pkgdown website URL.

BUG FIXES

MINOR IMPROVEMENTS

  • Updated standalone colorful_cli.
  • Beautified use_zzz with a spinner loading animation.
